items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: And I worked with Benny, Dave Bailey, Cy Frazier, and Faith So.

ctx.x: Well what were some of the bands that could really gut it?

Well you had a good many bands with gut, you see, after they get on the stand about two hours and they'd warm up, no telling what they was going to do. You understand? They'd get on and gut, you catch all of them in the gut. Now I had a habit, me and I'd make a man play. That was me always, you see I always had that feeling to play. And that man if he'd be drowsing and pulling back, well he'd wake up right now. Then I had a feeling I'd always get to my drum. When I got to my drum and get to working with my drums…
